Distant subduction earthquake.requires: a great earthquake across an ocean basin
Distant subduction earthquake.provides: hours of travel time, confident modelling, no local ground shaking

Local offshore earthquake.requires: a rupture close to the coast
Local offshore earthquake.provides: minutes of travel time, felt ground shaking as the only warning

Submarine landslide.requires: slope failure with or without an earthquake
Submarine landslide.provides: no seismic signature proportionate to the wave, very localised run-up

Volcanic flank collapse.requires: a coastal edifice failing into the sea
Volcanic flank collapse.provides: extreme local run-up, no useful precursor

Basin-wide warning centre.requires: seismic and sea-level networks across the basin
Basin-wide warning centre.provides: authoritative bulletins within minutes, only for seismically generated waves

Coastal siren network.requires: installed sirens and a trigger authority
Coastal siren network.provides: immediate alerting of a defined coastal strip, nothing to anyone indoors or inland

Cell broadcast to handsets.provides: reach of everyone carrying a handset, failure if the network is down

Natural warning only.requires: people recognising shaking or sea withdrawal
Natural warning only.provides: no institutional latency at all, dependence on public knowledge

Dense coastal city.requires: high-rise construction on a low coastal plain
Dense coastal city.provides: vertical evacuation feasible, very large exposed population

Low-lying fishing village.provides: no vertical refuge whatsoever, short distance to high ground

Resort with transient visitors.requires: a population unfamiliar with the coast
Resort with transient visitors.provides: no local knowledge, no idea where high ground lies

Port and industrial zone.provides: economic exposure, few lives at risk

Horizontal movement inland.provides: removal from the inundation zone entirely

Vertical evacuation in place.provides: survival above the wave, no movement needed

Shelter without evacuation.requires: a belief that the site is safe
Shelter without evacuation.provides: no movement, total dependence on that belief being correct

Spontaneous flight.provides: movement without coordination, congestion on any route
